title: Flying Waters - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Flying Waters in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A flooded area built around a huge anchor, holding the route to Noco's Hut and the game's second mandatory boss. It is also the area where the Bourgeon and Demineur side content sits.

sections.title: How to Reach Flying Waters
sections.content: Reached from Spring Meadows heading east. It is on the critical path, so you cannot miss it.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Goblu, Bourgeon, Mime, Bruler, Cruler, Demineur, Chromatic Bourgeon, Chromatic Bruler, Chromatic Troubadour

sections.title: Collectibles & Notable Loot
sections.content: Abysseram, Brulerum, Deminerim, Troubadim, Coral Cave hook
